coding.note: Seeds: sigma_seed (std across random seeds) is used to define the data-experiment metric (p.23), but no run counts or variances are reported for results, so I coded NR conservatively. Tokens: the total is not stated as one number; it can only be summed from the LR schedule (7.2T + 3.2T + 1T, about 11.4T). Those page-24 lines are interleaved with figure text, so the quote gives the batch-size schedule instead. Compute: 1500-2500 H800 GPUs are stated but no duration, so N. MoE vs dense is an isoflop comparison at different model sizes shown only as curves, so PARTIAL. PostNorm (DeepNorm) vs PreNorm has a matched ablation in Table 5 but is not claimed as novel in the abstract or introduction. The global router is claimed as novel in Section 2 only, so it is borderline for claim scope. The three-stage long-context procedure and the alignment claims are left out because page 3 is interleaved with figure text and no clean quote exists. Rerun/copied are MIXED: the authors evaluate comparators only 'if not reported'. LongBench v2 comparator scores are copied from the leaderboard site, which does not count as third-party evaluation of MiniMax.
